description: This file contains implementation of Vulkan format utilities for the ANGLE project, including format support checks, format initialization, swizzle mapping, and related helper functions.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Represents Vulkan format details, including format IDs, Vulkan formats, and support functions.

classes.name: FormatTable
classes.description: Manages a collection of Format objects and initializes them based on renderer capabilities.

methods.name: FillTextureFormatCaps
methods.description: Populates TextureCaps based on renderer format support and device limits.

methods.name: HasFullBufferFormatSupport
methods.description: Checks if a buffer format has full support for vertex buffer feature bits.

methods.name: FindSupportedFormat
methods.description: Finds the first supported format from a list based on a support test function.

methods.name: Format::initImageFallback
methods.description: Initializes image format fallback based on support and format properties.

methods.name: Format::initBufferFallback
methods.description: Initializes buffer format fallback based on support and format properties.

methods.name: Format::getImageCopyBufferAlignment
methods.description: Calculates the required buffer alignment for image copy operations.

methods.name: Format::hasEmulatedImageChannels
methods.description: Checks if the format emulates image channels that are missing in the actual format.

methods.name: FormatTable::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the format table with supported formats and populates texture capabilities.

methods.name: GetMaximalImageUsageFlags
methods.description: Returns the maximal image usage flags supported for a given format.

methods.name: MapSwizzleState
methods.description: Maps internal swizzle state based on format and context.
